text: Ledger guests: web — fold, list menu Guests section, create dialog, form, balances, post-join chooser, strings

Delegated to an Opus subagent in worktree .claude/worktrees/guests-web (branch guests-web); the orchestrator reviews the diff, aligns strings with Android, cherry-picks onto main, runs the gate and closes.

Subagent delivered e8362335 on guests-web (vitest 821 pass; the 2 failures are protocolVersion.test.ts, which needs all three constants at 4). Orchestrator review: fold/aliases/rosterIds/resolveParticipant/frozenReasonOf match design sections 4, 6 and 8; every screen computes on folded entries; former numbering over effective ids; chooser consumes ?joined once and only on an open ledger with unclaimed guests. Accepted deviations: web gates the Guests card and chooser on the list object carrying a guests key (the web has no serverProtocol — the bundle is served by its own server, T-327 precedent); the create-dialog section is ungated for the same reason; Reimburse for a locked guest is hidden like a voter's; balances rows stay in largest-credit order. Left for integration: docs/wire-contract.md (server ticket); widen the one-client-only check in crossClient.test.ts to guest.*; eight English strings the web agent worded were sent to the Android agent to match.

Landed on main: 5307a1d8 (subagent: fold, labels, Guests card, create dialog, form, balances, chooser, strings), 8cb8878a (one-client-only check covers guest.*) and 17be55cd (strings aligned to Android's renderings in nine locales; 'for everyone' folds keys). Verified: full gate green; vitest 823 passed including the shared fold group, the three fold properties and 29 page tests; 26 mutants caught by the subagent.
